overall_prep_notes: Total prep time across all 13 assets is approximately 2 hours. The bulk is M3 Paper Kittens (printed and laminated for the pet-shop scenario), M5 Story Problem Cards (18 cards), M7 Paper Cookies with halves and fourths (pre-cut along fraction-lines), and M9 Multiplication/Division Fact Triangles (24 cards). Two-colour counters (M2) and the double ten-frame mat (M1) are standard. The three character puppets (Mae, Dan, Buddy) should be printed on cardstock for years of reuse.

assets.name: Double Ten-Frame Mat
assets.purpose: Letter-size mat with two stacked ten-frames. Used in Lesson 1 for fact modelling and make-ten strategy.

image_placeholders.description: A double ten-frame mat in B&W line-art on a landscape letter page. Top half shows a 2x5 ten-frame grid (10 cells, labeled 'TOP'). Bottom half shows another 2x5 grid (labeled 'BOTTOM'). Cell borders are thin solid black lines.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image M1_DOUBLE_TEN_FRAME: keywords (ten-frame, mat) name what the page shows.

teacher_prep_steps: Print 1 mat per child (20+ pages for class of 20).
Laminate every page so children can use dry-erase markers.
Hand out at the start of Lesson 1.
Collect at the end of Lesson 1.
Optional: print extras for emerging-learner small group review.
assets.quantity_per_class: 1 mat per child = 20+ for a class of 20.

assets.name: Two-Colour Counters
assets.purpose: Round counters, red on one side, yellow on the other. Used for fact modelling, story-problem building, and array construction.
assets.page_layout: Not printable — physical counters from the classroom math kit.

image_placeholders.description: A storage-bag label, ~3in × 4in, in B&W line-art. Shows two stacked counters (red side / yellow side) with header 'TWO-COLOUR COUNTERS — 30 per pair'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image M2_COUNTERS_LABEL: keywords (counters, label) name what the label shows.

teacher_prep_steps: Confirm class set of two-colour counters (30 per pair = 300 for a class of 20).
Print storage labels; tape to zip-top bags.
Sort into per-pair bags before Lesson 1.
Have bags ready at the start of Lessons 1, 2, 3, and 5.
Optional: use red and yellow paper circles if foam unavailable.
assets.quantity_per_class: 30 counters per pair = 300 for a class of 20.

assets.name: Paper Kittens
assets.purpose: Set of 20 printable paper kitten tokens. Used in Lesson 3 for the pet-shop equal-groups scenario and Lesson 5 for division-as-equal-sharing.
assets.page_layout: 2 letter pages, portrait. Each page holds 10 kittens in a 2x5 grid.

image_placeholders.description: A paper kitten token in B&W line-art, ~2in tall. Round-faced kitten with simple smile and whiskers. Repeated 20 times across 2 pages in a 2x5 grid each.
image_placeholders.placement: 10 kittens per page in a 2x5 grid.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image M3_KITTEN_TOKEN: keywords (kitten, token) name what the token shows.

teacher_prep_steps: Print 2 pages on cardstock per group.
Laminate every page.
Cut into 20 individual kitten tokens.
Sort into per-group bags (~5 sets for a class of 20 in groups of 4).
Refresh annually if tokens get bent.
assets.quantity_per_class: 20 kittens per group = ~5 sets for a class of 20.

assets.name: Baskets Template
assets.purpose: Letter-size template with 6 basket outlines for grouping kittens (or any items) into equal groups.

image_placeholders.description: A baskets template in B&W line-art on a portrait letter page. 6 wicker basket outlines in a 2-row × 3-column grid. Each basket ~2.5in wide × 2in tall with a thin black outline.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image M4_BASKETS_TEMPLATE: keywords (baskets, template) name what the page shows.

teacher_prep_steps: Print 1 template per pair.
Laminate every page.
Hand out at the start of Lesson 3.
Collect at the end of Lesson 5.
Optional: print extras for stations.
assets.quantity_per_class: 1 template per pair = 10+ for a class of 20.

assets.name: Story Problem Cards
assets.purpose: Deck of 18 letter-size story problem cards: 6 change-add-to, 6 change-take-from, 6 part-part-whole. Totals up to 100. Used in Lesson 2.
assets.page_layout: 9 letter pages, portrait. 2 cards per page.

image_placeholders.description: A story-problem card in B&W line-art, ~5.5in × 4in. Top section shows the story text. Bottom section shows a small illustration matching the story (Mae with kittens for change-add-to, Mae with cookies for change-take-from, Mae and Dan with mixed items for part-part-whole). Card border is thick black outline. Card number bottom-right.
image_placeholders.placement: Two cards per letter page, stacked vertically.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image M5_STORY_CARD: keywords (story, card) name what the card shows.

teacher_prep_steps: Print 9 pages on cardstock.
Laminate every page.
Cut each page in half to make 18 individual cards.
Sort by problem type (6 change-add-to, 6 change-take-from, 6 part-part-whole). Colour-code corner stickers.
Distribute 6 cards per station for Lesson 2 rotations.

assets.name: Array Grid Mat
assets.purpose: Letter-size grid mat with rows and columns labeled 1-6. Children place counters to form arrays for multiplication.

image_placeholders.description: An array grid mat in B&W line-art on a landscape letter page. 6×6 grid of empty squares. Row labels 1-6 on the left edge; column labels 1-6 on the top edge. Each cell ~1.2in × 1.2in.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image M6_ARRAY_GRID: keywords (array, grid) name what the page shows.

teacher_prep_steps: Print 1 mat per pair.
Laminate every page.
Hand out at the start of Lesson 3.
Collect at the end of Lesson 3.
Optional: print extras for stations.
assets.quantity_per_class: 1 mat per pair = 10+ for a class of 20.

assets.name: Paper Cookies
assets.purpose: Set of ~24 printable paper cookie tokens. Some pre-cut along half-lines, some along fourth-lines. Used in Lesson 4 for half-group and fourth-group activities.
assets.page_layout: 3 letter pages, portrait. Each page holds 8 cookies.

image_placeholders.description: A paper cookie token in B&W line-art, ~2in diameter. Round shape with chocolate-chip dots. Some cookies have a dotted half-line dividing them; others have crossed dotted fourth-lines (4 sectors). 24 cookies total across 3 pages.
image_placeholders.placement: 8 cookies per page in a 2x4 grid.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image M7_COOKIE_TOKEN: keywords (cookie, halves) name what the token shows.

teacher_prep_steps: Print 3 pages on cardstock per group.
Laminate every page before cutting.
Cut into 24 individual cookie tokens.
Pre-cut about 8 cookies along the half-line into halves. 8 along the fourth-lines into fourths; leave 8 whole.
Store in a labelled bag; refresh annually.
assets.quantity_per_class: 24 cookies per group = ~5 sets for a class of 20.

assets.name: Sharing Paper Plates
assets.purpose: Set of 6 paper plates per group. Used in Lesson 5 for division-as-equal-sharing.
assets.page_layout: Not printable — real disposable paper plates.

image_placeholders.description: A storage-bag label, ~3in × 4in, in B&W line-art. Shows a stack of 4 paper plates with header 'SHARING PLATES — 6 per group'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image M8_PLATES_LABEL: keywords (plates, label) name what the label shows.

teacher_prep_steps: Prep this step carefully. Buy a pack of small disposable paper plates (6 per group = ~30 for a class of 20 in groups of 4).
Print storage labels; tape to plate stacks.
Sort into per-group sets before Lesson 5.
Have plates ready at the start of Lesson 5.
Reuse plates across the week if clean.
assets.quantity_per_class: 6 plates per group = ~30 for a class of 20.

assets.name: Multiplication/Division Fact
assets.purpose: Set of 24 laminated triangle cards. Each shows 3 numbers of a multiplication/division fact family at the corners with × and ÷ icons in the centre.
assets.page_layout: 4 letter pages, portrait. 6 triangles per page in 2x3 grid.

image_placeholders.description: A multiplication/division fact-family triangle card in B&W line-art, ~3in tall. Equilateral triangle with 3 circles at corners (top circle = product, two bottom circles = factors). Centre of the triangle has a small × / ÷ icon. Cut lines around each card.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image M9_TRIANGLE_CARD: keywords (triangle, fact) name what the card shows.

teacher_prep_steps: Print 4 pages on cardstock.
Laminate every page before cutting.
Cut into 24 individual triangle cards.
Sort by smallest factor (2s, 3s, 4s, 5s, 6s) — colour-code corner stickers.
Distribute 6 cards per pair for Lesson 5 Station B.

assets.name: The Equal Groups Workshop
assets.purpose: Large classroom anchor chart showing the four operations (+, -, ×, ÷) with example representations. Posted Lesson 1, referenced all week.
assets.page_layout: 1 large-format letter page, portrait — printed at tabloid size if possible, or assembled from 4 letter pages tiled together.

image_placeholders.description: The Equal Groups Workshop anchor poster in B&W line-art, ~17in × 22in. Top section shows the workshop facade with Mae and Dan inside. Middle section has 4 strategy/operation rows: Addition (+), Subtraction (-), Multiplication (×) with a 'GROUPS OF' icon, Division (÷) with a 'SHARED BY' icon. Bottom section has Buddy with a delivery cart waving.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image M10_WORKSHOP_POSTER: keywords (workshop, poster) name what the poster shows.

teacher_prep_steps: Print 4 letter pages and tile, OR print 1 tabloid page if available.
Laminate the assembled poster.
Tape to the front classroom wall on Day 1.
Reference the operations rows during every lesson.
Store rolled at the end of the unit for re-use next year.
